title: Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Card Benefit: Return Protection on Crew Teardown
content:
Cardholder benefit on changed-mind refunds of Northgate Special Order merchandise under Northgate Purchases & Returns, on a sale line that earned no Annual Reward. The benefit depends on how the purchase was paid and on the Northgate Credit Cards signature card the member holds active.

## Card return protection on the crew teardown

When the purchase was paid with the Northgate Visa and the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus, none of the teardown is withheld; when the purchase was paid with the Northgate Visa and the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Signature, or the purchase was paid with any other tender and the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus, half of the teardown is withheld; otherwise all of the teardown is withheld.

The tender is the purchase's recorded primary tender; the card is the member's Northgate Credit Cards account in status active. The crew teardown withheld is the returned units times the teardown rate per unit times the share withheld (0, 0.5 or 1), rounded half up to the cent.

| Purchase tender | Active signature card held | Share of the teardown withheld |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Visa | Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | 0 (none) |
| Northgate Visa | Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | 0.5 (half) |
| any other tender | Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | 0.5 (half) |
| any other tender | Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | 1 (all) |
| any tender | neither card active | 1 (all) |

## Worked shares (hypothetical teardown)

3 returned units at a teardown rate of 15.00: with a half share, 3 multiplied by 15.00 multiplied by 0.5, that is 22.50, withheld; with no share, nothing; with the full share, 45.00.
